title: Use of NO-resorbable dPTFE membranes in preservation of the alveolar ridge-a case report 12
authors: Spirov V, Veljanovski D, Baftijari D, Papraniku K, Stojanovski M. Clinical Oral Implants Research. 2020 Oct; 31: 296-296. doi: 10.1111/clr.234_13644.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss permamem (dense PTFE) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “and Clinical Implications: The use of NO -resorbable dPTFE membranes, which allow open healing of extraction wounds, in combination with bone substitutes of xenogenic origin, gives predictable and reliable results in the preservation of extraction wounds with minimal bone loss” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
